Observed recording has no buffer holds; timings measure generated-pose visibility, not prompt-semantic onset.

Other inherited fields such as frames=160, request_id, chunk_metadata and service_result also describe the original source request; actual arraylength876 and immediate parent/prefix hashes are authoritative for saved lineage.
